caveats: Baseline pools use exact calendar windows of +/-5 days around each day-of-year, including the 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05 shoulder days exactly as specified; 29 February values enter the pools of their calendar neighbours. Day 60 of the climatology/threshold is the mean of days 59 and 61 before smoothing. All comparisons done in float64 on stored kelvin values. An alternative day-of-year-window reading of the pooling rule changes thresholds only at winter/leap-seam doys (1-10, 55-65, 357-366), far from the June-August target band, and yields a bitwise-identical MHW mask and the same single regional event.
